inventory.notes: No pref is read in this file's lines; zoom.stealth.webgl.shader_output_language is read indirectly through webgl::StealthDeclaredShaderOutput (WebGLShaderValidator.cpp). When the declared language differs from the driver's, the shader is translated a second time through ANGLE on every compile, so non-Windows builds with the pref set pay for an extra translation per shader. A failed second translation keeps the driver output and emits NS_WARNING. The stored string is cleared before the success check, so a failed compile cannot leave a stale value. The ~14 logic lines can move into a helper in an own file behind a one-line call. Comments are in Italian and one comment carries a warning emoji (U+26D4).

verifier.why: The added lines in this file do not name or read any pref; the pref is read only inside StealthDeclaredShaderOutput() in WebGLShaderValidator.cpp.
